application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to the tree hereby approved shall only comprise the following and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010:

- The crown reduction should be by no more than back to the most recent previous pruning points or a maximum of 30% of crown volume. 

- No pruning cuts are to be made which are greater than 75mm in diameter.

To prevent unnecessary loss or mutilation to the tree, in accordance with Policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the trees (Email: TreesEnquiries@lbhf.gov.uk and Telephone 020 8748 3020).

To ensure that the Council has the opportunity to confirm the tree work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1 of this permission as well as policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
